chunks: When We said to the angels: "Bow before Adam in adoration," they all bowed but Iblis. He was one of the jinni and rebelled against his Lord's command. And yet you take him and his offspring as your friends instead of Me, even though they are your enemies. How sad a substitute for the evil-doers!

key_terms.إِبْلِيسَ: Iblis (the specific name of the devil)

ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam and what does it mean for humanity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ontological distinction between the angels, who are created from light and inherently obedient, and Iblis, who is from the jinn and possesses free will, explaining his deliberate disobedience. The command to prostrate (Sujud) is viewed not merely as physical bowing but as a sign of respect and submission to Adam's divine vicegerency, establishing the hierarchy of creation. This narrative serves as a foundational warning against taking Satan as a protector, emphasizing that his enmity is rooted in his own choice to defy God's command.
